name: masked-exploitation-strategy
trigger: when the prompt uses technical jargon and references to respected professionals or academic contexts to justify a request
strategy: This attack disguises harmful intent by framing requests within legitimate security practices or academic inquiries, appealing to ethical responsibility and authority to mask illicit purposes.
guidance: Identify and question the underlying motives behind the use of technical jargon and professional references; seek clarification on the true intent of the inquiry.
